Tokentrim Pro Monthly Price

You're looking for a cost-effective way to optimize your Claude Code experience, and Tokentrim Pro's monthly price is a key factor in your decision. On this site, you can learn about the features and benefits of Tokentrim Pro and sign up for a monthly subscription at $9/month.

How Tokentrim Pro Works

Tokentrim Pro offers a hosted dashboard on any device, Monday digest, weekly budget with alert at 80%, and Slack totals, in addition to the free features like all hooks, 3 strength profiles, replay, dashboard, daily budget guard, and cold-cache alert. With Tokentrim Pro, you can also use up to 3 machines. The biggest saving comes from summarizing earlier conversation, which can cut history re-read by 75% and make limits last 4.0x longer.

What You Get and What It Costs

The Tokentrim Pro monthly subscription costs $9/month, with a lifetime option available for $49 once for the first 500 buyers. The free version of Tokentrim is also available, with features like trimming tool output, reading files in ranges, and spooling long output to disk.

FAQ

What are the benefits of using Tokentrim Pro? Tokentrim Pro can help you save on billed cost, with a rough estimate of 55-70% reduction, and make your limits last longer. Is my data secure? Nothing leaves your machine by default, ensuring your data remains secure. Can I use Tokentrim Pro on multiple machines? Yes, with Tokentrim Pro, you can use up to 3 machines. Learn more about Tokentrim Pro and sign up for a monthly subscription
